mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_banner ( banner_id, site_id, banner_title, banner_location, file_group_id, alt_text, link_url, link_target, show_from, show_to, sort_order, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{bannerId}, #{siteId}, #{bannerTitle}, #{bannerLocation}, #{fileGroupId}, #{altText}, #{linkUrl}, #{linkTarget}, #{showFrom}, #{showTo}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn}, #{deleteYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
